crossRefs.note: Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.
The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness; and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.
“Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them…
and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’

translations.web: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.
translations.bsb: If a wise man goes to court with a fool, there will be raving and laughing with no resolution.
translations.kjv: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.
translations.asv: If a wise man hath a controversy with a foolish man, Whether he be angry or laugh, there will be no rest.
